scope: BYOM external-model connection verification; not a Model Catalog registration
label: fp8-demo-v2-w1

plan.stop_rule: stop at the first call that does not end completed (error, 5xx, timeout, failed, incomplete); no retry and no further call

d2-webiq-agent-fp8:2.instructions: 간결한 한국어로 답한다. 질문에 답하기 전에 반드시 web 도구를 먼저 호출하고, 그 도구 결과에 근거해서만 답한다. 도구 결과에 없는 내용과 URL은 쓰지 않는다. Web IQ 도구의 location 인자는 'lat:<위도>;long:<경도>' 형식(예: lat:37.5665;long:126.9780)으로만 넣고, 정확한 좌표가 없으면 location을 넣지 마라.

notes: Timestamps are UTC with millisecond precision from the client clock; match them with vLLM, APIM and span clocks by time window.

client_http counts the HTTP requests the OpenAI client sent for that call only: requests = conversation creation plus Responses POSTs, responses_posts = Responses POSTs. The client is created with max_retries=0. responses_statuses lists the HTTP status of each Responses POST that got an answer, in order; it is absent when none did, and fewer statuses than responses_posts means a POST without an answer.

request_budget is a client-side safety net, not a measurement: each call is counted as its Responses POSTs (at least 1) plus its mcp_call items (one more model request each), and a call is not started when the estimate so far plus 2 would exceed the budget. Gateway counts stay authoritative.
Foundry spans (invoke_agent, chat, execute_tool) are not collected here; read them from the telemetry side by call window and nonce.

output_hosts and answer_hosts name public hosts only (at most 20, found among the first 100 URLs); an IP address, an internal or tenant-specific name, an Azure resource host or a URL with user info shows as [masked-host]. answer_hosts_not_in_tool_output lists the public hosts of the final answer that no MCP output contained. output_shape holds key names and list lengths only, never values; result_items is the number of entries in the recognised result lists (webResults, newsResults, results, ...) and is absent when the output has none.

model_error is true when the call failed with HTTP 500 (or as a failed response) and the service error type or code is model_error. A 503 'model backend not ready' can carry the same code; it is not counted.
contaminated and contamination_note stay null until someone marks a call by hand because other traffic overlapped it; summary does not account for those marks.
response_model echoes the agent reference; it does not show which model served the call.
